reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Salto KS again
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again with your Salto KS account. You will be sent to the Salto KS login page, which always asks for your username and password, also when you are already signed in to Salto KS in this browser. Use the same account as before; another account is refused. To use another account, choose **Reconfigure** on the integration instead.

reconfigure.title: Switch Salto KS account

abort.already_configured: This Salto KS account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Salto KS account than the one this entry belongs to. To use another account, choose Reconfigure on the integration.
abort.cannot_connect: Signed in, but the Salto KS account details could not be read. Please try again.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out while preparing the sign-in.
abort.missing_configuration: The sign-in for Salto KS is not available.
abort.no_url_available: No Home Assistant address is available for the sign-in. See {docs_url}.
abort.oauth_error: The Salto KS login returned an invalid response.
abort.oauth_failed: The sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out while completing the sign-in.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: The Salto KS login refused the sign-in.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The sign-in for Salto KS is not available right now.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Switched to the new Salto KS account.

data_description.include_user_details: Store who caused an entry (name, alias, picture and user ID) in Home Assistant. This is personal data and is kept in the Home Assistant history. When off, only the event, time and lock details are stored.

set_easy_office_mode_schedule.name: Set Easy Office Mode schedule
set_easy_office_mode_schedule.description: Changes the Easy Office Mode schedule of one or more Salto KS locks in a single request per lock. Fields that are left out keep their current value.

auto_start.name: Auto start
auto_start.description: Unlock the lock automatically when the window starts.

days.name: Days
days.description: Weekdays on which the schedule applies. Days that are not selected are disabled.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Start of the daily window (local time).

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: End of the daily window (local time); the lock is locked automatically at this time.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day of the schedule (included). Set it to an empty value (null) to remove the end date, so the schedule runs indefinitely. Leave the field out to keep the current end date.

remove_easy_office_mode_schedule.name: Remove Easy Office Mode schedule
remove_easy_office_mode_schedule.description: Removes the Easy Office Mode schedule of one or more Salto KS locks. Locks without a schedule are skipped.
